question: How long does the compelled bodily obedience produced by this rite last?
premises: The rite makes the person follow bodily.
The effect can last for the duration of life.
The text asserts there is no doubt about this.
inference: One should make the person obedient in body for as long as life lasts, without doubt.
plain_english: One should make that person obedient in body for as long as life lasts; there is no doubt.
